title: Any two fibre functors on a Galois category are isomorphic
statement: Let $C$ be a category with morphisms in universe $u$ and a GaloisCategory structure in the Mathlib sense. Let $F,F\prime:C\to\mathrm{FintypeCat}_u$ be fibre functors in the Mathlib PreGaloisCategory.FiberFunctor sense: they preserve finite limits, finite coproducts, epimorphisms and quotients by finite groups and reflect isomorphisms. Then there exists a natural isomorphism $F\cong F\prime$.

source.place: nonempty_iso_of_fiberFunctor and its proved helpers homEquivSectionsFibers, bijective_app_of_fiberFunctor, isIso_of_fiberFunctor

proof.text: By Mathlib pro-representability, the fibre functor F is a colimit of the corepresentable functors of its pointed Galois objects. The universal property of this colimit identifies natural transformations F to F-prime with compatible sections of the F-prime fibres on pointed Galois objects. This is the proved homEquivSectionsFibers equivalence in the cited source.

The category of pointed Galois objects is cofiltered by Mathlib. Each F-prime fibre there is nonempty because the underlying Galois object is connected; it is finite because F-prime takes values in finite sets. Apply [lem-trf-cofiltered-finite-sets-section] to obtain a compatible section, hence a natural transformation eta:F to F-prime.

On a Galois object, eta is equivariant for its automorphism group. Evaluation of automorphisms at a fibre point is bijective for either fibre functor: equivariance and freeness give injectivity of eta, and equality of both finite fibre cardinalities with the automorphism group gives surjectivity. For a general object, lift a pair of points to one Galois object over its square; equality of their images gives equality of the two induced arrows by connected-object evaluation injectivity, hence equality of the original points. For surjectivity lift a target point along a Galois object and use bijectivity there. Thus eta is componentwise bijective, and consequently a natural isomorphism. These arguments are the proved bijective_app_of_isGalois, bijective_app_of_fiberFunctor and isIso_of_fiberFunctor helpers in the same source.
